learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the structure, function, and basic operating characteristics of DC and AC motors, as well as controlled drives.
They know the most important properties of basic electronic components and understand corresponding basic circuits.

syllabus_topics: Structure, function, ESB, and operating behavior of DC, synchronous, and asynchronous machines
Electric drives, speed control with motor control units and frequency converters
Procurement, quality, and reliability of electronic components
Simple heat transfer processes in electronic components
Locus, transfer function, and Bode diagram in simple RLC networks
Nonlinear resistors, semiconductors, function and structure of diodes, transistors, and OPs, simple circuits with diodes
Transistor as a switch, transistor and OP as an amplifier
teaching_methods: Lectures with integrated exercises, with whiteboard and beamer projection
Laboratory experiments (Electrical Measurement Technology, Electric Drives)

assessment_methods.method: Successful participation in practical lab work

assessment_rules: To pass, students must pass the module exam and successfully participate in the practical lab work. The grade weighting is based on ECTS credits.
bibliography: a list of suitable literature will be provided
Rolf Fischer and Hermann Linse: Elektrotechnik für Maschinenbauer, Springer-Verlag (e-book)
